name: Ruincraft ChillSkin Chrome Sleeve
description: Single-sleeve arm wrap designed to slide over chrome limbs and active augmentation, in pale grey phase-change fabric that absorbs body heat and releases it slowly. Street-brand construction — raw-edge hems, hand-stitched cooling gel channels, no branding except a small stamped ruin-cross on the wrist cuff. Prevents chrome overheating in 35C+ humidity without restricting movement.
functionality: Passive phase-change cooling for chrome limbs, gel-channel heat absorption, prevents aug overheating.
what_it_says: You've got chrome and you live somewhere that doesn't give you climate control — this is the solution.
story_hooks: The cooling gel channels are filled with something that isn't the standard compound — it works better, but nobody will say what it is.
Wearing one marks you as Shelf-born to anyone who grew up there.
